en.headline: Health officials say dating apps are hampering mpox tracing
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection says Hong Kong has logged 29 mpox cases this year, and that about six in ten recent patients met partners through apps.
body: Au Ka-wing, head of the communicable disease branch at the Centre for Health Protection, told an RTHK programme on Monday that mpox cases have risen since August and that investigators have not found a shared venue or event linking them.

The centre said Hong Kong has recorded 29 mpox cases this year, 22 of them local and seven imported, with 20 of those infections reported since August. Of the 20, Au said 15 were local and five imported. All of the patients were men who reported sex with men, and all said they had high-risk sex during the incubation period, including with strangers, with more than one partner, or without a condom.

He said about 60 per cent of the patients reported finding partners through dating apps, and that many could not give contact details, so the source of infection was unknown in some cases. The centre believes transmission is continuing inside a small circle rather than through one identifiable gathering.

The centre has stepped up messages on social media, including dating apps, is offering vaccine to higher-risk groups, and has added an extra vaccination point at the Centre for Health Protection building. Au urged people to keep a way of contacting sexual partners so tracing can be done if needed.

zh.headline: 歐家榮：交友程式令猴痘追蹤困難
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心表示本年累計29宗猴痘，八月以來20宗中約六成患者稱透過交友程式尋找陌生性伴侶。
body: 衞生防護中心傳染病處主任歐家榮星期一在港台節目表示，本港猴痘個案自八月起上升，流行病學調查暫未發現患者曾到同一地方或參加同一活動。
中心說，本年累計29宗，包括22宗本地及7宗輸入，其中20宗是八月以來新增。歐家榮指，這20宗之中15宗屬本地、5宗屬輸入，患者均為男男性接觸者，並表示在潛伏期內曾有高風險性行為，包括與陌生男性、與多名伴侶發生性行為，或沒有使用安全套。
他說約六成感染者稱透過交友程式尋找陌生性伴侶，不少人未能提供聯絡方法，部分個案因此無法確定感染源頭。中心相信傳播在一個細圈子內持續，而非源自單一可識別的聚集。
中心已在社交媒體及交友應用程式加強宣傳，為較高風險群組提供疫苗，並在衞生防護中心大樓增設接種點。歐家榮呼籲市民保留性伴侶的聯絡方法，以便有需要時追蹤。
